zh.title: 说明
items: 本版在 **0.0.1-beta.46** 之上，聚焦长会话与流式输出稳定性、代码阅读体验、用量统计准确性，以及 Desktop 主进程生命周期治理。
尚未公开的 **Appshots** 设置入口已隐藏，避免用户进入未完成的产品界面。

zh.title: 新功能与体验优化
items: **代码块与 diff 高亮**：Markdown 代码块支持语法高亮，并为 diff 内容提供增删行着色。
**文件树呈现优化**：改进文件节点的信息层级与浏览体验。
**统一 Desktop 玻璃质感**：整合窗口 chrome、vibrancy 布局和深色对比度，统一浮层圆角并优化搜索浮层层级。
**用量按请求归因**：账单与 token 用量按每次请求实际使用的 Provider / Model 记录。

zh.title: 稳定性修复
items: **长会话不卡主线程**：将高开销会话处理移出关键交互路径，降低长对话下的界面停顿。
**流式文本更平滑**：按动画帧调度增量文本，减少高频更新造成的抖动。
**压缩并发保护**：避免同一会话并发压缩，并展示真实失败状态；压缩后及时刷新上下文用量。
**Goal 状态连续性**：修复 handoff 终态保留与 runner 计时同步，避免恢复后状态回退。
**macOS Dock 恢复窗口**：主窗口关闭后，从 Dock 再次激活应用可正确重建窗口。
**Qoder 多模态与思考配置**：保留 FREE_INPUT 中的 `image_url` 内容，并同步 thinking effort / `reasoning_effort`。
**用量数据准确性**：不再把缺失的 cache-write token 伪报为 0。
**测试隔离**：Conversation Store 测试不再读写用户真实数据。
**界面细节**：修复外观预览重复标题、代码换行丢失、diff 行多余空白等问题。

zh.title: Desktop 架构与发布保障
items: **单一 Composition Root**：Electron Main 使用命名启动阶段，明确 fatal / optional 语义、反向回滚、幂等清理和聚合错误。
**受治理的启动顺序**：Local Runtime 就绪后注册 Desktop IPC，再创建首个 Renderer 窗口。
**IPC 与 preload 单一目录**：集中管理频道、注册 owner 和 sandbox preload 投影，禁止 `main.mjs` 直接注册 IPC。
**资源释放可追踪**：统一管理窗口、Tray、快捷键、Updater、OAuth 回调、监听器和订阅的生命周期。
**Updater 语义保持**：Windows 已下载更新在清理后继续 `quitAndInstall()`，其他状态保持原有行为。
**共享 runtime 边界**：Desktop 与 TUI 通过 `@peer-agent/runtime-node` 复用宿主中立能力，避免反向依赖。
**架构门禁**：新增生命周期、IPC、依赖方向、Overlay 和 motion primitive 的自动化检查。

zh.title: CLI / npm
items: GitHub Releases 继续提供 CLI 归档，例如 `peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz`。
安装：`npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@beta`。
`peer --version` 应输出 `peer 0.0.1-beta.47`。

en.title: Overview
items: Built on **0.0.1-beta.46**, this beta focuses on long-conversation and streaming stability, code readability, accurate usage accounting, and governed Electron Main lifecycle ownership.
The unreleased **Appshots** settings entry is now hidden so users cannot enter an unfinished product surface.

en.title: Features and UX improvements
items: **Highlighted code and diffs**: Markdown code blocks now support syntax highlighting and add/remove coloring for diff content.
**Improved file tree**: Refined file-node hierarchy and browsing presentation.
**Unified Desktop glass styling**: Consolidated window chrome, vibrancy layout, dark-mode contrast, overlay radii, and search-popover hierarchy.
**Per-request usage attribution**: Billing and token usage are attributed to the Provider and Model actually used for each request.

en.title: Reliability fixes
items: **Responsive long conversations**: Moves expensive conversation work away from critical interaction paths to reduce UI stalls.
**Smoother streaming text**: Paces incremental text updates with animation frames.
**Compaction concurrency guard**: Prevents concurrent compaction for one conversation, surfaces real failures, and refreshes context usage after compaction.
**Goal continuity**: Preserves terminal handoff state and keeps runner timing synchronized after recovery.
**macOS Dock reopen**: Recreates the main window when the app is activated from the Dock after the window was closed.
**Qoder multimodal and reasoning fixes**: Keeps `image_url` parts in FREE_INPUT and aligns thinking effort with `reasoning_effort`.
**Accurate usage data**: Missing cache-write tokens are no longer reported as a fabricated zero.
**Safer tests**: Conversation Store tests no longer read or write real user data.
**UI polish**: Fixes duplicate appearance-preview titles, lost code line breaks, and extra blank spacing in diff lines.

en.title: Desktop architecture and release safeguards
items: **Single Composition Root**: Electron Main now uses named startup phases with fatal/optional semantics, reverse rollback, idempotent cleanup, and aggregated errors.
**Governed startup order**: Desktop IPC is registered after Local Runtime is ready and before the first Renderer window is created.
**Single IPC and preload catalog**: Centralizes channels, registration owners, and sandbox preload projection; direct IPC registration in `main.mjs` is governed out.
**Traceable resource cleanup**: Windows, Tray, shortcuts, updater, OAuth callbacks, listeners, and subscriptions have explicit lifecycle owners.
**Preserved updater semantics**: A downloaded Windows update resumes `quitAndInstall()` after cleanup while other states retain their existing behavior.
**Shared runtime boundary**: Desktop and TUI reuse host-neutral capabilities through `@peer-agent/runtime-node` without reverse dependencies.
**Architecture gates**: Adds automated checks for lifecycle ownership, IPC boundaries, dependency direction, Overlay usage, and motion primitives.

en.title: CLI / npm
items: GitHub Releases continue to include CLI archives such as `peer-darwin-arm64.tar.gz`.
Install with `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@beta`.
`peer --version` should report `peer 0.0.1-beta.47`.
